clusters.name: After the birth of the third child, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half of Bea's birth, Lena was described as worn out and on edge, then she and Paul grew distant with him working late, you had stomach aches and missed school, Paul and Jonah fell into shouting matches, and Lena did not go back to her job, all falling close together before a long quiet stretch follows.
